articles.headline: NBA championship and Finals MVP odds: Knicks maintain odds-on favorite status after Game 3 loss
articles.description: San Antonio's win in Game 3 created a big shift to the odds, but New York remains the favorites as the Knicks head into Game 4 with a 2-1 series lead.

images.name: Karl-Anthony Towns [1296x729]
images.caption: Karl-Anthony Towns, Jalen Brunson and the Knicks remain odds-on favorites heading into a massive Game 4 at MSG.
images.alt: Karl-Anthony Towns #32 and Jalen Brunson #11 of the New York Knicks high five during the game against the San Antonio Spurs during Game Three of the 2026 NBA Finals on June 8, 2026 at Madison in New York, New York.
images.credit: Nathaniel S. Butler/NBAE via Getty Images

images.name: Victor Wembanyama defends Karl-Anthony Towns [608x342]
images.caption: Winners of 13 straight playoff games, the Knicks head to New York as big title favorites.
images.alt: Victor Wembanyama defends Karl-Anthony Towns

images.name: Jalen Brunson [1296x729]
images.caption: Jalen Brunson led all scorers with 30 points in an impressive Game 1 win over the Spurs.
images.alt: Jalen Brunson #11 of the New York Knicks dribbles the ball during the game against the San Antonio Spurs during Game One of the 2026 NBA Finals on June 3, 2026 at Frost Bank Center in San Antonio, Texas.
images.credit: Nathaniel S. Butler/NBAE via Getty Images

images.name: Victor Wembanyama [1296x729]
images.caption: Victor Wembanyama (center left) and the San Antonio Spurs are favored entering the NBA Finals.

images.caption: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and Victor Wembanyama are Nos. 1 and 2 in the Finals MVP odds, respectively.

images.name: Jalen Brunson [608x342]
images.caption: Jalen Brunson has the New York Knicks in the NBA Finals for the first time since 1999.
images.alt: Jalen Brunson

images.name: Knicks/Cavs [1296x729]
images.caption: The Knicks are looking to end the series against the Cavaliers tonight, as they have the second-shortest title odds and are an overwhelming favorite to win the East.
images.alt: New York Knicks guard Landry Shamet (L) defends Cleveland Cavaliers guard Donovan Mitchell (R) during game 3 of the NBA East Conference Finals between the Cleveland Cavaliers and the New York Knicks in Cleveland, Ohio, USA, 23 May 2026.

images.name: Jalen Brunson [608x342]
images.caption: The Knicks are now heavy favorites to win the Eastern Conference after taking a 3-0 series lead over the Cavs.
images.alt: Jalen Brunson
images.credit: Nathaniel S. Butler/NBAE via Getty Images

article.headline: Okoro's season-high 24 points lead short-handed Bulls past Pelicans 134-118
article.description: — Isaac Okoro scored a season-high 24 points, Tre Jones added 20 points and 12 assists and the depleted Chicago Bulls topped the New Orleans Pelicans 134-118 on Wednesday night.

article.story: CHICAGO -- — Isaac Okoro scored a season-high 24 points, Tre Jones added 20 points and 12 assists and the depleted Chicago Bulls topped the New Orleans Pelicans 134-118 on Wednesday night. Matas Buzelis had 19 points, Jalen Smith had 14 points and 14 rebounds, and Nikola Vucevic had 17 points for a Chicago team playing without its top two scorers in Josh Giddey and Coby White, who were injured in a loss to Minnesota on Monday night and are expected to miss several games. All five Chicago starters reached double figures, as did three bench players — Ayo Dosunmu, Kevin Huerter and Patrick Williams. Zion Williamson led New Orleans with 31 points and Jordan Poole added 26 off the bench in the team's fifth straight loss. The Bulls asserted their up-tempo style, scoring 25 points on the fast breaks, while holding their own with the Pelicans in the paint (60 points to 56). Chicago leveraged New Orleans fouls in an game that often turned physical. Chicago connected on 25 of 34 on free throws for the game after struggling from the stripe in the first half. Chicago led 97-90 entering the fourth quarter, then opened the lead to 17 points. Giddey (left hamstring tightness) will be reevaluated in two weeks and White (right calf tightness) in one, the team said Sunday. The Bulls also said center Zach Collins (sprained right toe) will be reevaluated in 10 days. He missed Monday’s game. Pelicans guard Jose Alvarado served the second of a two-game suspension stemming from his fight on Saturday night with Phoenix’s Mark Williams. Chicago led 67-62 at the half. Okoro scored 16 points in the opening 24 minutes. Williamson consistently plowed into the paint to score 20 of his, including nine in a row late in the second quarter. Up next Pelicans: Host Portland on Friday night. Bulls: Host Orlando on Friday night. ------ AP NBA: https://apnews.com/hub/NBA
